description: Trade History. Calls only GET /v4/trades and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching trade history, volume, and metrics for any supported Solana AMM or DEX program, filtered by program.

authorityAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

baseMintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

feePayerAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

limit.description: Limit of the number of trades to return per page. Default/max is 1000.

marketAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

minBaseAmount.description: Minimum base-side (input) token amount to filter trades by.

minQuoteAmount.description: Minimum quote-side (output) token amount to filter trades by.

minValueUsd.description: Minimum USD value of the trade to filter by (direction-agnostic).

mintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

programAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

quoteMintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

resolution.description: Enumeration of supported resolution deprecated values for time range or aggregation configuration.

sortByAsc.description: Sort ascending by 'price' or 'blockTime'. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

sortByDesc.description: Sort descending by 'price' or 'blockTime'. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

timeEnd.description: End time of the data to return (unix timestamp)

timeStart.description: Start time of the data to return (unix timestamp)

name: list-trades
title: Trade History
